scripts.check:syntax: find js scripts cloudflare -type f \( -name '*.js' -o -name '*.mjs' \) -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 node --check && node --check sw.js
scripts.validate:catalog: node scripts/validate-catalog.mjs && node scripts/validate-hero-layout.mjs && node scripts/validate-legacy-catalog-merge.mjs && node scripts/validate-favorites-queue.mjs
scripts.validate:cloudflare: node scripts/validate-cloudflare-migration.mjs && npm run check:admin-worker && npm run check:lyrics-txt-metadata && npm run check:track-quality && npm run check:cloudflare:ops
scripts.check:wrangler:admin: npm run build:admin-worker && wrangler deploy --dry-run --config cloudflare/wrangler.admin.jsonc --outdir dist/wrangler/admin
scripts.check:wrangler: npm run check:wrangler:public && npm run check:wrangler:admin
scripts.deploy:cloudflare:admin: npm run build:admin-worker && wrangler deploy --strict --config cloudflare/wrangler.admin.jsonc
scripts.validate:media-regressions: node scripts/validate-media-regressions.mjs && node scripts/test-lyrics-autoscroll.mjs && node scripts/validate-pwa-update.mjs && node scripts/validate-audio-startup.mjs && node scripts/validate-mobile-studio.mjs && node scripts/validate-canvas-layout.mjs && node scripts/validate-smart-canvas.mjs && node scripts/validate-canvas-identity.mjs && node scripts/validate-admin-access.mjs
scripts.validate: npm run check:syntax && npm run validate:catalog && npm run validate:cloudflare && npm run test:service-worker
